common.title: Knowledge Work Is Boosted, Not Replaced
common.line: The evidence arrives from ordinary offices rather than from laboratories: measured productivity gains in law, accountancy, administration, journalism and consulting, largest among the least experienced, and no matching fall in employment.

notable.title: Frontier Access Denied
notable.line: The Union is cut off from the leading model at short notice, wholly or by nationality of user.

notable.title: Paper records breach
notable.line: Municipal paper-fallback archives built during the ransomware cordons are exfiltrated and published, triggering a cross-border privacy and fraud crisis that discredits manual continuity.

notable.title: Shadow biomed market
notable.line: Underground clinics advertise unvetted AI-designed antivirals and decontamination protocols, drawing patients away from cordon hospitals and creating a parallel care market authorities cannot trace.
